controls.label: Structure
controls.hint: What stands in the yard to knock down: a timber-framed barn, a steel water tower, a brick wall or a chimney.

controls.label: Weld strength
controls.hint: How strong the welds holding the pieces together are, against what each one carries standing. Rebuilds the structure.

controls.label: Cannonball
controls.hint: How big the iron cannonball is (its radius): 12 cm is 56 kg, and twice that is eight times as heavy and hits far harder.

controls.label: Speed
controls.hint: How fast time runs: below 1 is slow motion.

controls.label: Ball speed
controls.hint: How fast the cannonball flies when it is fired.

controls.label: Density
controls.hint: Every material's density, scaled: heavier pieces load their welds more and hit harder when they fall. Rebuilds the structure.

controls.label: Friction
controls.hint: Every material's friction, scaled: low and rubble slides apart, high and it piles up. Rebuilds the structure.

controls.label: Gravity
controls.hint: How hard everything is pulled down once the structure stands. Welds are set for 9.81, so more brings a weak structure down on its own.

controls.label: Solver iterations
controls.hint: Solver passes a step: fewer is cheaper and softer, more is stiffer.

controls.label: Keep firing
controls.hint: Fires at the structure every two seconds by itself, and rebuilds it once it is down, until turned off.

controls.label: Camera shake
controls.hint: Whether the camera shakes when a ball is fired and things land.

triggers.label: Rebuild
triggers.hint: Puts the structure back up, whole, and clears away the rubble and cannonballs.
